'''Lancer4life (VSC) Virtual Card Contest My Way''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lancer4life]]
* '''Published:''' 17 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HB Lancer4life LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

This is my deck, My way

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Response to Reviews, It is not a space orientated deck, Its is a mains battle deck.  If all goes right a one turn beat down will be all i need.

This deck is simply complicated to describe i think.  Basically your first turn involves Pulling Endor System and Endor DB and Crix into hand. Also Solo into hand.  Signal for I wonder who They found.  Second turn you get crix out to get chewie to get wuta so you can pull the Back Door.   Then you want to get solo out with I wonder who they found to pull that's one count me in and I'm With you too.  Get Daughter and Jedi luke out as fast as possible.  Now you have The combo going and everyone has a weapon from Sai'Torr kal fas.  Use signal to get effects out and use boshek to get the comlink so you can move to the backdoor and stay at the docking bay and drain with sabers and the admirals order to add.

Of course don't just stay on endor if they look to be playing a deck you must attack them then bring it.

this is the first stage of this deck.  A friend and i have been trying this since before the V-Cards so if you could e-mail me or post suggestions that would be really cool thanks.


Lancer4life@aol.com
